brief:
Iran's foreign minister blamed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for attempting to draw Washington into war against Tehran, Middle East Eye reported. Araghchi used pointed language in his criticism, describing Netanyahu as a "serpent" working to manipulate American policy. The comments came as Iran warned the United States against conducting further military operations.

Senior US military commanders have raised concerns about potential overstretch of American forces in the region. The tensions reflect deepening friction between Tehran and Israel over military positioning and the scope of potential American involvement in any future conflict. Iran has intensified its warnings to Washington following recent military developments.

title: Iran's Araghchi accuses Netanyahu of pushing US toward conflict
